## About
Auto-Serv is a car repair and maintenance shop at 3003 Johnson Ferry Rd in Marietta, right next door to the McDonalds. The owner, Robert Del Pozzo, is an ASE certified master technician, and regulars just call him Rob.
We handle the everyday work that keeps a car running, from oil changes, filters and fluid flushes to brakes, steering and suspension, cooling systems, HVAC, electrical problems and emissions repair.
Customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 50 Google reviews. If you can't make it in during the day, you can leave your keys in our drop box overnight.

## Services
- Brakes: We look at your brakes and track down problems like a grinding noise.
- Steering and suspension: Repair work on steering and suspension systems.
- Rotate and balance: Part of our regular maintenance work, along with oil changes, filters and fluid flushes.

## FAQ
Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Give us a call to schedule an appointment over the phone.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. Overnight drop offs are available. Leave your keys and a description of the service you want in the drop box by the office door.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Johnson Ferry Rd in Marietta, next door to the McDonalds.
